positive.title: Package signature, bundle manifest, and source receipts
Engine, identity, trust, and manifest preflight
Exact composite host and client authentication
Exact mlkem768x25519-sha256 KEX and approved AEAD cipher
At least one rekey under the same exact profile
PID-bound authenticated readiness before application transit
Deterministic target payload through the loopback listener
Clean stop, restart, host-key rotation, client-key rotation, revocation, and package upgrade

Expired, reused, altered, cross-server, and cross-target invites
Shell, exec, subsystem, SFTP, SCP, remote, dynamic, agent, X11, stream-local, and TUN forwarding
Listener collision, process substitution, runtime-directory replacement, and state-file mutation
